run_benchmark: run a benchmark evaluating a model on a dataset with autoregressive or self-speculative generation
build_evaluation_metrics: build an EvaluationMetrics instance with ROUGE, BLEU, and timing metrics for text generation evaluation
process_cli_arguments: process CLI arguments to parse model, benchmark, and generation config dataclasses
create_benchmark_arguments: create BenchmarkArguments to configure dataset, num_samples, n_shot, and template for benchmarking
main_entry: run the main benchmark entry point that loads a model, benchmarks it, and saves JSON results
